profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a dedicated software developer in the dynamic and ever-evolving world of technology. I take pride in delivering high-quality software that not only meets client requirements but also exceeds their expectations. 

My mission is to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, continually improving my skills and staying updated on industry trends. I'm excited about collaborating on projects that harness the power of these technologies to create cutting-edge solutions.

I'm always eager to connect with like-minded professionals, share insights, and explore potential collaborations. If you're interested in discussing how we can work together to achieve software development excellence, don't hesitate to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Python)
positions.description:
Architected and deployed a serverless, microservices-based Vacation Booking platform on AWS (S3, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, WAF, Route 53) with full CI/CD automation using GitLab and the Serverless Framework.
Implemented real-time features using Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK; ensured high availability through Active/Active deployment across multiple AZs with health checks and failover mechanisms.
Secured APIs using Lambda Authorizers and AWS WAF with IP whitelisting for third-party integrations; enforced idempotent requests and validation for reliability and data integrity.
Developed high-performance asynchronous web applications and APIs using aioHTTP for scalable and efficient data handling.
Integrated AI Chatbot functionalities into Python applications, enabling natural language understanding and automated responses.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer( Python Fullstack)
positions.description:
- Created a robust RESTful API using the Flask framework to facilitate communication between the frontend and backend systems for the speech-to-text conversion process.
- Designed and implemented an end-to-end speech-to-text conversion system using Python, integrating SIRI’s machine learning model for transcription.
- Managed data storage by saving transcribed files to a Solr search database, metadata to Cassandra, and audio files to AWS S3 for efficient retrieval.
- Implemented client and server functionalities with aioHTTP, ensuring robust and non-blocking network operations for real-time applications.
- Automated system processes using AWS CloudWatch and Celery/Redis for producer-consumer queues, ensuring timely processing of audio files.
- Oversaw the transcription of approximately 120K audio files daily, leveraging around 120 servers to handle 4000 minutes of audio per host.
- Developed audio processing and privacy-enhanced algorithms to merge customer and advisor audio files in chronological order for conversation building.
- Utilized Pydub to process audio files in chunks, analyzing audio-level features such as silence to improve transcription quality.
- Implemented the Spacy and BERT models to scrub private information (e.g., names, locations) from final transcripts, ensuring compliance with privacy standards.
- Integrated a Word Error Rate (WER) metric for assessing transcription accuracy.
- Managed the deployment of the application across 120 servers using custom Python scripts, ensuring smooth operation and minimal downtime.
- Automated the containerization process of Python applications by creating Docker files and custom Docker images, reducing deployment time.
- Developed a CI/CD pipeline for automated deployment, streamlining the process from code integration to production deployment, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
- Utilized Python to build APIs serving AI Chatbot outputs, enhancing user interaction and intelligent automation.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Python  Fullstack)
positions.description:
- In the development of DocPat, a robust doctor-patient web portal utilized by over 2,500 users, I leveraged a tech stack that included Python, Django-REST, ReactJS, and PostgreSQL.
- Created a dynamic front-end portal for doctors using ReactJS, ensuring a seamless user experience.
- Additionally, Implemented RESTful APIs and employed JWT authentication for secure access, all facilitated through the Django- REST framework.
- The PostgreSQL database served as the backbone for data management, enabling efficient storage and retrieval of patient information.
- This comprehensive approach ensured a secure and user-friendly platform for both healthcare providers and patients.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Python  Fullstack)
positions.description:
- Engineered a concurrent system to process millions of SWIFT banking transactions, converting them to JSON format. 
- Utilized Python, Django-REST, and MySQL to build a robust data processing framework.
- Implemented data cleaning and structuring using REGEX and pandas for effective transaction analysis.
- Developed a user management dashboard with ReactJS to enhance user experience and accessibility.
- Created automated testing functions using Selenium to ensure system reliability and performance.
- Integrated Pytest for comprehensive testing, enhancing code quality and robustness of the application.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Python)
positions.description:
- Served as a dedicated full-stack developer for a personalized news magazine web application using Python and Django.
- Implemented a mailing system and REST APIs to enhance user engagement and facilitate content delivery.
- Integrated external news and blog APIs to provide diverse feeds on the application dashboard.
- Developed advanced filtering algorithms to categorize and personalize news content for users.
- Utilized MySQL for efficient data storage and retrieval, ensuring optimal performance.
- Employed Pytest and Selenium for rigorous testing, ensuring high reliability and quality of the application.

projects.title: Estimated Wait Time (EWT) – Data Analytical Tool
projects.description:
● An analytical tool for ML-team to predict estimated wait time of customer care calls.
● Developed an analysis script to calculate the customer-agent stats by processing unstructured logs using REGEX and
Pandas. Using pagination process 100K log-files and then save structured (analyzed) files to S3.

projects.title: Conversion-Kit, Web Services
projects.description:
● PIPELINE & SYSTEM: End-to-end system for speech-to-text conversion using python and SIRI’s ML-model.
○ Store transcribed files to Solr search database, metadata to Cassandra, and audio files to AWS-S3.
○ Automate(Cron job) the system using AWS cloud watch and Celery/Redis producer-consumer queues.
○ System transcribes ~120K audio files in 1-day using ~120 servers (4000 minutes of audio per host per day).
● ALGORITHM: Development of Audio processing and privacy enhanced algorithm.
○ Merge customer and advisor audio files in time sequence to build conversations.
○ Process audio files in chunks using Pydub with audio-level features, for example, silence.
○ Using the “Spacy and BERT” model, scrub private information from final transcripts, for example, name, location.
○ Word Error Rate (WER) metric implementation for assessing transcriptions.
● TEST & DEPLOYMENT: Perform “Regression testing” and deploy over 120 servers using custom Python script.
○ Created Splunk dashboard to visualize the system.
